framework: NIST Cybersecurity Framework 2.0 — Helix Robotics mapping

controls.title: Organizational Mission and Objectives
controls.description: The organizational mission is understood and informs cybersecurity risk management. Helix has a documented security program objective: protect customer PII and payment data, maintain availability of Tier-0 services, and meet SOC 2 Type II commitments.
controls.helix_implementation: Security program charter in Notion (updated 2025-Q4). Reviewed annually by CTO.
controls.gap: No formal risk appetite statement approved by the board. Risk thresholds for accepted risks (e.g., HELIX-1822 SSRF) are informal.

subcontrols.title: Security charter reviewed annually by CTO

controls.title: Asset Inventory
controls.description: Physical devices, virtual infrastructure, and software components are inventoried. Helix maintains a CMDB (services.csv) and cloud account inventory (cloud-accounts.csv).
controls.helix_implementation: CMDB in services.csv (updated quarterly). AWS resource tagging policy enforced via SCP. Cloud accounts in cloud-accounts.csv.
controls.gap: CMDB does not include SaaS tools (Snowflake, Datadog, PagerDuty). Open: HELIX-2105.

subcontrols.title: CMDB maintained in services.csv, reviewed quarterly
AWS resource tagging enforced via SCP in Organizations

controls.title: Software Asset Inventory
controls.description: Software platforms and applications within the organization are inventoried. Helix tracks service dependencies via SBOM generation in CI.
controls.helix_implementation: SBOM generated by Syft in GitHub Actions for Python and Go services. Stored in S3. Not yet integrated with a vulnerability tracking tool.
controls.gap: SBOM not consumed by any automated vulnerability correlation system. Manual process to map CVEs to Helix services. Open: HELIX-2107.

subcontrols.title: Syft SBOM generation in CI for all services

controls.title: Vulnerabilities Identified and Documented
controls.description: Vulnerabilities in assets are identified, validated, and recorded. Helix runs Dependabot for dependency vulnerabilities and Inspector for container scanning.
controls.helix_implementation: Dependabot enabled on all repos. AWS Inspector for EKS container scanning. Security Hub aggregates findings.
controls.gap: No SLA defined for vulnerability remediation. Critical CVEs have been open >30 days (see Security Hub). Open: HELIX-2106.

subcontrols.title: Dependabot PRs auto-assigned to service owners
AWS Inspector enabled on prod EKS cluster

controls.title: Identities and Credentials Managed
controls.description: Identities and credentials for authorized users, services, and hardware are managed and authenticated. Helix uses Okta for human identity and Vault for service identity.
controls.helix_implementation: Okta SSO + TOTP MFA for all humans. Vault AppRole and IRSA for service identities. Offboarding via Okta Workflows (<24h). Quarterly access reviews in Vanta.
controls.gap: OAuth2 client secret rotation schedule not enforced (open: HELIX-2113). Service accounts in analytics account not in Okta lifecycle management.

subcontrols.title: Okta SSO + TOTP MFA for all human accounts

controls.title: Access Privileges Managed
controls.description: Access privileges, entitlements, and authorizations are defined in a policy, managed, enforced, and reviewed. Helix enforces least privilege via IAM policies and Vault ACLs.
controls.helix_implementation: IAM policies managed in Terraform with mandatory code review. Vault ACLs reviewed quarterly. Break-glass procedure for pii-vault (two-person approval).
controls.gap: analytics-cross-account IAM role is overly broad (findings HELIX-2098, HELIX-2099, HELIX-2100). K8s RBAC for pii-vault grants cluster-wide secrets/get (HELIX-2101).

subcontrols.title: IAM policies managed in Terraform with PR review

controls.title: Data at Rest Protected
controls.description: Data at rest is protected. Helix encrypts all production datastores using AWS KMS.
controls.helix_implementation: All RDS instances encrypted with KMS CMKs. S3 buckets use SSE-KMS. EBS volumes encrypted. pii-prod-pg uses customer-managed CMK (alias/helix-pii-prod).
controls.gap: CMK deletion protection not enforced via SCP — a key administrator could schedule deletion without a second approval. Open: HELIX-2111.

subcontrols.title: KMS CMK encryption on all RDS instances
S3 SSE-KMS on all production buckets

controls.title: Networks Monitored to Find Potentially Adverse Events
controls.description: Networks and network services are monitored to find potentially adverse events. Helix uses VPC Flow Logs, CloudTrail, and Datadog for security monitoring.
controls.helix_implementation: VPC Flow Logs → CloudWatch → Datadog. CloudTrail management events in all accounts. Sigma rules deployed to Elastic SIEM. Four Sigma rules active (see detections/).
controls.gap: Sigma rule coverage limited to 4 rules. ATT&CK technique coverage map shows gaps in Lateral Movement and Defense Evasion tactics. Open: HELIX-2115.

subcontrols.title: VPC Flow Logs enabled and retained 90 days
CloudTrail management events in all 5 accounts
Sigma rules for auth anomaly, SSRF, exfil, and Vault
